description: A Jupyter Notebook containing Python code for setting up and querying a document index using llama_index with Gemini LLM and Google PaLM embeddings, including document processing, index persistence, and sample queries.

classes.name: ServiceContext
classes.description: A class for managing service context including language model and embedding model settings.

classes.name: StorageContext
classes.description: A class for managing storage and persistence of index data.

methods.name: from_defaults
methods.description: Creates a default instance of ServiceContext with specified models.

methods.name: load_data
methods.description: Loads documents from a specified directory.

methods.name: from_documents
methods.description: Creates an index from a list of documents.

methods.name: persist
methods.description: Persists the index storage context to disk.

methods.name: from_defaults
methods.description: Creates a default StorageContext with specified directory.

methods.name: as_query_engine
methods.description: Converts the index into a query engine for querying documents.

methods.name: query
